brief: A seed-starting tray of at least four cells, each with a draining bin.

requirements.requirement: At least four cells in the tray
requirements.evidence: 4 base cells placed at 0,0,0; -1,0,0; 0,1,0; 1,0,0 forming a compact cluster

requirements.requirement: Each cell has a draining bin
requirements.evidence: bin:0,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:0,1,0~hex-bin-full-drain, bin:1,0,0~hex-bin-full-drain - all 'drained' variants with drainage holes, filled with soil and planted

finish.summary: Built a 4-cell hex cluster tray with a full-depth drained bin in each cell, filled with soil and seedlings for demonstration. Caps and joint bolts applied.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
